title: Solace AI
desc: Product concept, visual identity and website for an imagined AI wellness companion.
lead: I created Solace as a self-initiated AI wellness concept, shaping its product direction, identity and website.
body: I wanted to explore how an AI companion could feel quieter and more approachable. For Solace, I developed the product concept alongside a visual identity built from a simple three-part symbol, cyan accents and soft, atmospheric imagery.
detail: I carried that direction into desktop and mobile website presentations, typographic posters and social applications. Dark landscape imagery and warm neutral backgrounds give the bright cyan elements room to stand out.
contribution: Owned the concept and set the product and visual direction.
Designed the identity, colour palette and brand applications.
Designed website presentations for desktop and mobile.
